grpc.services: Label of the list of gRPC services loaded from the server or from .proto files.
grpc.reflection: Shown when the services come from server reflection. Server reflection is a gRPC feature.
grpc.load: Button that loads the services. Short.
grpc.reload: Button that loads the services again. Short.
grpc.method: Label of the picker for a gRPC method.
grpc.useExample: Button that fills the message with a generated example. Short.
grpc.kinds.unary: gRPC call kind: one request, one response.
grpc.kinds.bidirectional: gRPC call kind: both sides send a stream.
grpc.kinds.client: gRPC call kind: the client sends a stream.
grpc.kinds.server: gRPC call kind: the server sends a stream.
grpc.replaced: {{names}} is a list of .proto file names. Gostman matches each import line to an added file by its name, so it can hold only one file per name.
